page_title: VIL 0-2 BAR | Villarreal v Barcelona 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
90+3' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90+1' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' A pass into the penalty area from Raphinha (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Alberola signals.
87' The linesman raises his flag. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
85' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends the corner into the box, but Luiz Junior intercepts it and averts the threat.
84' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
81' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
80' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes it short.

80' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' Raphinha (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
79' Problems for Hansi Flick as Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Marc Casado replaces him.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
77' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Joan Garcia.
75' Marcelino has decided to substitute Nicolas Pepe and he is replaced by Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal).
75' Substitution. Dani Parejo did his best and is replaced by Carlos Macia (Villarreal).
73' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sees a yellow card from Javier Alberola after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
73' The attendance is 20701.
72' The game is interrupted as Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
72' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

69' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Joan Garcia shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
66' Today's match ends for Eric Garcia who will be replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
65' That will be all from Ayoze Perez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal).
63' 0 - 2 Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
62' Ferran Torres goes off the pitch and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) comes on.
62' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
62' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) replacing Fermín.
60' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
58' A yellow card for a tackle by Eric Garcia (Barcelona). Javier Alberola doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
56' Half-chance! Fermín (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Luiz Junior reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Fermín (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
54' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Barcelona have a corner.
53' Fermín (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
49' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

47' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Luiz Junior makes a great save to stop his effort.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+1' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is able to continue to play.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Javier Alberola shows a red card with no hesitation. Renato Veiga (Villarreal) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.

38' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
37' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

37' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Joan Garcia anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
36' Raphinha (Barcelona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola no option but to blow his whistle.
35' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
34' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is flagged for offside.
32' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
27' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

25' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
24' Referee Javier Alberola sees the trip by Fermín (Barcelona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
19' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

16' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Raphinha (Barcelona) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
15' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
14' So close! Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
12' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Raphinha (Barcelona) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Luiz Junior no chance!
12' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Barcelona!
10' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
9' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Joan Garcia.
9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
7' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner with a short pass.
7' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Villarreal win a corner.
5' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
2' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Barcelona earn a corner.
1' The match has just started.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
